measurement_description: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark, ECHO, evaluates the ability of LLMs to role-play as ordinary individuals by having acquaintances of those individuals distinguish between human and machine-generated responses across various general and personal question categories, such as 'Philosophical Questions' and 'Values and Beliefs', which are not specific to any religious context.
